_comment: Every external input of the heat map pipeline, pinned. fetch_latest.py downloads exactly these bytes and stops on a checksum mismatch. To take newer data: run fetch_latest.py --discover, review what changed upstream, then bump the commit/url/sha256 here in a PR (the data expert audits the result).

mirror.name: civillizard/saudi-real-estate-data
mirror.holds: MOJ sale deals 2020-Q1..2026-Q1 (2025-Q2 file is a mislabelled 2024-Q2), REGA sales by district to 2025-Q4 (Q3 partial), REGA rents to 2026-Q1, MOJ transfer counts by city to 2026-Q2

moj_overlays.publisher: MOJ sale deals Apr-Jun 2026 in the Ministry's own layout, republished by a public GitHub analysis repo (YazeedFAlmuhlaki/Saudi-Real-Estate-Market-Analysis, data/raw)
moj_overlays.licence: Saudi Open Data License (MOJ data). Attribute: Ministry of Justice

moj_overlays.publisher: KSA Land Data (Tarkib) free quarter sample on Hugging Face, from the Ministry's public real-estate transactions report (moj.gov.sa). Ministry fields unmodified

moj_overlays.publisher: KSA Land Data (Tarkib) free quarter sample on Hugging Face (every sale of 2026-Q3), from the Ministry's public real-estate transactions report (moj.gov.sa). Ministry fields unmodified
moj_overlays.licence: Saudi Open Data License (ODC Attribution). Attribute: Ministry of Justice
